name: power-digital-twin
description: Create downloadable, validated Power Digital Twin JSON from guided electrical requirements or user-supplied specifications and single-line drawings.

interface.shortDescription: Text to Grid JSON｜文字生電力圖
interface.longDescription: EW AI Power Digital Twin guides users from plain-language electrical requirements, tenders, design specifications or single-line drawings to a validated, downloadable Power Digital Twin JSON file. The file can be opened in AI Power Digital Twin Dynamic Simulation System for continued review, drawing, EDC meter-channel binding and governed VeraGrid simulation. / EW AI Power Digital Twin 將文字需求、標書、設計規範或單線圖轉成可驗證、可下載的 Power Digital Twin JSON；使用者可在 AI 電力數位雙生動態推演系統繼續校對、繪圖、定位 EDC 電錶通道，並在通過工程閘門後進行 VeraGrid 推演。
defaultPrompt: Create a downloadable power-system JSON from my description. / 請把我的描述轉成可下載的電力系統 JSON。
Guide me through missing ratings, then export JSON. / 請引導我補齊設備規格，再匯出 JSON。
Convert my specification or single-line diagram to JSON. / 請將規範或單線圖轉成 JSON。
